claim_summary: TraceBench contributes a simulation-based benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on time-series root-cause attribution under controlled context, noise, support-example, and submission conditions.

claim_evidence.quote: In summary, our contributions are the following: First, we introduce TraceBench, a simulation-based framework for generating root-cause attribution tasks along four controllable axes: domain context, observation noise, labeled examples, and submission

notes: One benchmark module groups its diagnostic task generation, filtering, and submission/scoring protocol. Off-the-shelf agent scaffolds, libraries, and classical baselines are excluded. Root-cause classification is counted under diagnosis rather than as a separate task family. Process evidence is limited to trace/artifact inspection metrics, not comprehensive execution-success rates. Temporal evidence concerns held-out information access, not chronological forecasting splits. Evaluation cost measures runtime resources, not downstream decision utility.
